GBR.gmv_source_quote: In 2030 the revenue will have increased for sixth consecutive years to 159.31 billion U.S. dollars.

NLD.gmv_source_quote: In 2024, Dutch consumers spent roughly 36 billion euros on online purchases. The Netherlands is the seventh-largest e-commerce market in Europe in absolute terms.
